# Remove the root Makefile generated by XcodeBuildMCP incremental builds

## Lesson
After an XcodeBuildMCP simulator build uses `xcodemake`, check the repository root for an untracked generated `Makefile` and remove it from the implementation diff.

## Why it matters
The generated file contains machine-specific build paths and command output and can accidentally pollute an otherwise focused worktree.

## Evidence
The Phase 0 production build created a root `Makefile` that was absent during the clean preflight; it identified itself as generated from the XcodeBuildMCP `xcodebuild` invocation.
